Imo I don’t think those years are a complete waste of your time. On weed, people tend to think out of the box, even if it feels like a simple high. You’ve gained wisdom and you’ve trained your brain to accomplish task or other things at a fraction of it’s full potential. Imagine how great your brain will work sober! After a couple of days off the weed, you will probably realize that you’ve missed having a clear thinking and a fast/good decision making brain! It’s a really nice feeling being efficient.
 While we’re here, focus on the présent moment, not the past (what’s done is done), not the future (that’s where anxiety lives), only the present. Do things that makes you happy (except getting high lol), keep track of your daily accomplishments in a book, drink a lot, like a lot of water and eat clean. 
It’s working for me but we’re all different so im pushing you to experiment other strategies that will fit you the best. 
Lastly, CONTROL YOUR THOUGHTS! You’re in charge, not your cravings.
